title: Looks Nice, But Cheap
text: Looks Nice, But Cheap. I am giving this 5 stars for appearance and 2 for quality. Standard Chinese quality ceramic with a durability factor of next to nothing. It is attractive and a nice size. I like the seal around the lid, but  I've had things with that kind of seal before and they don't hold up well to continual use. Kind of surprised since I have been getting things from this manufacturer for a while now and the quality is usually better.
